column1: # zh-Hans: working-tree snapshots, their restore and delete, and the Settings section.
NiceGit saves copies of your working files while they change. Pick a snapshot to see what differs from now.
column2: NiceGit 会在工作文件变化时保存它们的副本。选择一个快照，查看它与当前文件的差异。

column1: No snapshots yet. NiceGit saves them as your files change.
column2: 还没有快照。文件变化时 NiceGit 会保存快照。

与现在相比有 {count} 个文件不同

column1: Select a snapshot to see its files.
column2: 选择一个快照，查看其中的文件。

column1: Ticked files are written back to their saved versions. Your current versions are kept in a snapshot first.
column2: 勾选的文件会恢复为保存的版本。当前版本会先保存为一个快照。

column1: Save or close the file you are editing before restoring files.
column2: 恢复文件前，请先保存或关闭正在编辑的文件。

column2: 此文件不在快照中，因此无需恢复。

column1: Select a file to see what changed since the snapshot.
column2: 选择一个文件，查看自快照以来的变化。

column1: This file in your working tree is replaced with its saved version.
column2: 工作区中的此文件将被替换为保存的版本。

column2: 工作区中的这 {count} 个文件将被替换为保存的版本。

column1: Your current versions are saved as a snapshot first, so this can be undone.
column2: 当前版本会先保存为快照，因此可以撤销。

column1: The snapshot is removed from this repository. Its files cannot be restored from it afterwards.
column2: 快照将从此仓库中删除。之后将无法再从它恢复文件。

column1: Saved copies of your working files, to bring lost files back
column2: 工作文件的已保存副本，用于找回丢失的文件

column1: Save snapshots of my working files
Snapshots stay in this repository under refs/nicegit/snapshots and are never pushed by NiceGit. A git push --mirror would send them. Files over 20 MB are skipped.
column2: 快照保存在此仓库的 refs/nicegit/snapshots 中，NiceGit 从不推送它们。但 git push --mirror 会将其一并推送。超过 20 MB 的文件会被跳过。
